text: Ironvale Athletic effectively exploited Redmond Rovers' high press and high defensive line with a well-executed counter-attack starting from a free kick deep in their half. Their sequence involved precise, direct vertical passing, culminating in a through ball from Oskar Lindgren to Jonah Lindqvist, who finished confidently from close range (xG 0.685) to put Ironvale ahead 2-1[#1154] [#1156] [#1157]. Redmond’s pressing left them vulnerable after a foul by Teo Osei, allowing Ironvale the space and time to build their attack patiently but quickly. The coaching point: when using a high press against a counter-attacking team like Ironvale, ensure tighter coordination to prevent conceding space behind the defensive line on set-piece restarts.
